factions.name: Damage Dealer
factions.description: Deal very high damage and carry a large health pool; strong against Tanks and Assassins, weak against Marksmen and Artillery.

factions.name: Tank
factions.description: Very high health made to absorb damage and lead the charge; strong against Assassins, weak against Damage Dealers.

factions.name: Assassin
factions.description: Close the distance to a target quickly with high mobility; low health means they rely on evasion and cunning to survive.

factions.name: Support
factions.description: Keep allies healed, buffed, or otherwise assisted during a fight.

factions.name: Controller
factions.description: Area denial and battlefield control; open up opportunities for allies and restrict enemy movement.

factions.name: Marksman
factions.description: Pick off enemies one by one from long range, but are vulnerable up close to Assassins and Artillery.

factions.name: Artillery
factions.description: Lob or launch projectiles over long distances and ignore cover, but have low mobility and struggle against Tanks and Assassins.

cards.name: Shelly
abilities: Super: piercing shotgun blast that knocks back and destroys cover
cards.description: The default starting Brawler; a shotgun-wielding Damage Dealer with high close-range burst and a knockback Super.

cards.name: Colt
abilities: Super: twelve-bullet piercing volley that destroys obstacles
cards.description: Long-range six-shooter Damage Dealer with a very fast reload and a wall-piercing Super.

cards.name: El Primo
abilities: Super: flying leap that damages and knocks back on landing
cards.description: One of the tankiest Brawlers; punches enemies up close and charges his Super by taking damage.

cards.name: Poco
abilities: Super: wide musical wave that heals self and teammates
cards.description: A guitar-playing Support who heals teammates with nearly every attack and his Super.

cards.name: Bull
abilities: Super: charging dash that damages enemies and destroys obstacles
cards.description: A high-health, close-range shotgun Tank who charges his Super by taking damage.

cards.name: Nita
cards.description: Attacks with piercing shockwaves and summons her bear Bruce with her Super for extra close-range pressure.

cards.name: Barley
abilities: Super: five fire bottles that cover a wide area
cards.description: An Artillery bartender who lobs damaging liquid bottles that pool on the ground and deny areas without needing line of sight.

cards.name: Jessie
cards.description: Bounces electric shots between enemies and deploys the Scrappy turret with her Super to defend or distract.

cards.name: Piper
abilities: Super: grenades at her feet followed by a retreat jump
cards.description: A very long-range Marksman whose umbrella shots deal more damage the farther they travel.

cards.name: Edgar
abilities: Super: mobility jump over obstacles with a speed boost
cards.description: A fast, self-healing Assassin whose short-range punches heal him on every hit.

cards.name: Mortis
abilities: Super: summons a swarm of healing bats
cards.description: A shovel-dashing Mythic Assassin who heals from his bat-swarm Super and defeated enemies.

cards.name: Tara
abilities: Super: black hole that pulls in and damages enemies
cards.description: A Mythic Damage Dealer whose piercing tarot cards and black-hole Super pull enemies together for follow-up damage.

cards.name: Leon
cards.description: A Legendary Assassin who turns invisible with his Super to ambush enemies or make a fast escape.

cards.name: Spike
abilities: Super: thorny projectile that creates a slowing, damaging spike patch
cards.description: A cactus-brawling Legendary Damage Dealer whose exploding attacks and area-denial Super punish grouped enemies.

cards.name: Sandy
abilities: Super: sandstorm that grants stealth to self and allies
cards.description: A Legendary Controller whose sandstorm Super hides himself and allies from enemy fire.

cards.name: Surge
abilities: Super: leaping jump that upgrades his attack and movement on landing
cards.description: A Chromatic Damage Dealer who evolves his attacks and speed each time he lands his jump Super.
